[data-slot=\"table-container\"][data-edg.-webkit-mask-image:
linear-gradient(
      to right,
      transparent,
      black var(--zk-table-fade),
      black calc(100% - var(--zk-table-fade)),
      transparent
    )

:root[data-identity=\"mist\"], [data-ide.--zk-font-sans:
"Inter Variable", Inter, "Inter Variable Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto,
